fomod.Name: Civil War Champion
fomod.Author: ApocryphaRealm
fomod.Description: The champion's armour of the Civil War, handed to you by Ulfric Stormcloak or General Tullius before the final assault - not won in a duel, and not collected at the battle. Standalone: it needs no Creation Club content, no Thaumaturgy and no Guards Armor Replacer. Tempering recipes only; the set cannot be forged.
